name: Demon of Fate's Design
oracle_text:
Flying, trample
Once during each of your turns, you may cast an enchantment spell by paying life equal to its mana value rather than paying its mana cost.
{2}{B}, Sacrifice another enchantment: This creature gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is the sacrificed enchantment's mana value.
blocked_sentences: Once during each of your turns, you may cast an enchantment spell by paying life equal to its mana value rather than paying its mana cost.

needs.what: a player-wide static granting an alternative cost to enchantment spells you cast, priced as life equal to the spell's own mana value, usable only during your turn and at most once per turn (counted per source, spent only when the alternative cost is actually used)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: granted_alternative_cost takes a fixed cost spec with integer values (casting.py coerces each to int), so it cannot charge pay_life equal to the spell's mana value, and it neither reads static_max_per_turn nor gates on your turn; pay_life_instead charges life equal to mana value but exists only on cast_from_library_top, which is a zone permission, not a hand-cast alternative cost; free_cast_permission is free and unlimited
